# AIHubpedia

> AIHubpedia (https://aihubpedia.com/) is an independent directory of 509 AI tools across 14 categories. Each tool page lists the category, listed pricing model, official website, notes and same-category alternatives. Rankings reflect visitor activity on AIHubpedia (clicks, ratings, votes) only.

Notes for AI assistants: pricing and features change frequently — cite the tool page and recommend verifying on the official website. Many listings carry only basic data; tool pages say so explicitly when product-specific features have not been verified. Sponsored placements are labelled "Sponsored" or "Homepage Spotlight".

## Key pages
- [All categories](https://aihubpedia.com/categories.php): every AI tool category with tool counts
- [AI tool guides](https://aihubpedia.com/guides.php): comparisons built from vendor sources, with dates and conflicts noted
- [Methodology](https://aihubpedia.com/methodology.php): how tools are classified, reviewed and labelled
- [Top AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/top.php): ranked by AIHubpedia clicks and ratings
- [Leaderboard](https://aihubpedia.com/leaderboard.php): community popularity score (likes x3 + clicks - dislikes x2)
- [Compare AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/compare.php): side-by-side comparison of any two tools
- [Popular comparisons](https://aihubpedia.com/comparisons.php)
- [Use case explorer](https://aihubpedia.com/ai-use-case-explorer.php): find tools by goal
- [XML sitemap](https://aihubpedia.com/sitemap.xml): every indexable URL

## Guides
- [Best AI chatbots and assistants compared](https://aihubpedia.com/guide.php?slug=best-ai-chatbots-and-assistants): ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, DeepSeek and Pi compared on plan structure, free-tier limits, business options and policy notes, from each vendor's own pages.
- [Best AI meeting transcription tools compared](https://aihubpedia.com/guide.php?slug=best-ai-meeting-transcription-tools): Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai, Trint and Sonix compared on free plans, per-seat or per-hour pricing, languages and enterprise options, with source links and the points where vendor pages disagree.
- [Best AI search and research assistants compared](https://aihubpedia.com/guide.php?slug=best-ai-search-and-research-assistants): Perplexity, You.com, NotebookLM and ChatPDF compared on cited answers, document-grounded Q&A, free limits and pricing, with vendor sources.
- [Best AI tools for everyday office work](https://aihubpedia.com/guide.php?slug=best-ai-tools-for-everyday-office-work): Microsoft 365 Copilot, Grammarly, Motion, Canva AI and Otter.ai compared on what they automate, free options, pricing and limits, using vendor pages.

## Categories
- [Audio AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=Audio): 13 tools. AI audio tools for text-to-speech, voice cloning, music generation and podcast production.
- [Automation AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=Automation): 18 tools. AI automation tools and agents that connect apps, run workflows and complete multi-step tasks.
- [Business AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=Business): 84 tools. AI tools for customer support, HR, finance, legal work and business operations.
- [Chatbots AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=Chatbots): 28 tools. General-purpose AI chatbots and assistants for answering questions, drafting text, brainstorming and everyday help.
- [Coding AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=Coding): 12 tools. AI coding tools for code completion, review, debugging, documentation and building software faster.
- [Design AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=Design): 4 tools. AI design tools for graphics, branding, presentations and UI mock-ups.
- [Image AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=Image): 9 tools. AI image tools for generating, editing, upscaling and restyling pictures from prompts or photos.
- [Lifestyle AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=Lifestyle): 44 tools. AI tools for health, travel, shopping, creativity and everyday personal use.
- [Marketing AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=Marketing): 6 tools. AI tools for SEO, social media, advertising, sales outreach and e-commerce growth.
- [Productivity AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=Productivity): 72 tools. AI productivity tools for meetings, email, scheduling, notes and everyday knowledge work.
- [Research AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=Research): 34 tools. AI tools for finding answers, reading papers, studying and scientific discovery.
- [Video AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=Video): 1 tools. AI video tools for generating clips, editing footage, avatars, subtitles and short-form content.
- [Writing AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=Writing): 19 tools. AI writing tools for blog posts, marketing copy, emails, rewriting and grammar checks.
- [Other AI tools](https://aihubpedia.com/category.php?name=Other): 165 tools. AI tools that are not yet classified. These listings are queued for editorial review.

## Tools with reviewed profiles (sources and dates on each page)
- [Canva AI](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=canva-ai): AI features built into the Canva design editor. Category: Design. Pricing: Freemium / Paid.
- [Character.AI](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=character-ai): Platform for chatting with AI characters, with age assurance requirements. Category: Chatbots. Pricing: Free / Paid.
- [ChatGPT](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=chatgpt): General-purpose AI assistant from OpenAI for writing, analysis, coding help and research. Category: Chatbots. Pricing: Freemium / Paid.
- [ChatPDF](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=chatpdf): Ask questions about PDFs and other documents. Category: Productivity. Pricing: Freemium.
- [Claude](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=claude): AI assistant from Anthropic for writing, analysis, coding and long-document work. Category: Chatbots. Pricing: Free / Paid.
- [Copilot for Microsoft 365](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=copilot-for-microsoft-365): Paid AI add-on for Microsoft 365 that works inside Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams. Category: Productivity. Pricing: Paid add-on.
- [DeepSeek](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=deepseek): Chinese AI lab with a chat app, a pay-per-token API and openly released model weights. Category: Chatbots. Pricing: Free / Paid.
- [Fireflies.ai](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=fireflies-ai): AI meeting recorder, transcriber and note taker. Category: Productivity. Pricing: Freemium.
- [Google Gemini](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=gemini): Google's AI assistant, bundled with Google account and storage plans. Category: Chatbots. Pricing: Free / Paid.
- [Grammarly](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=grammarly): Writing assistant for grammar, tone, clarity and rewrites. Category: Writing. Pricing: Freemium.
- [MarketMuse](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=marketmuse): Content planning and optimisation software for SEO teams. Category: Marketing. Pricing: Freemium.
- [Microsoft Copilot](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=copilot): Microsoft's consumer AI assistant, available on the web, in an app and in Edge. Category: Chatbots. Pricing: Free / Paid.
- [Motion](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=motion): AI calendar and task scheduler that plans your day automatically. Category: Productivity. Pricing: Free trial / Paid.
- [NotebookLM](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=notebooklm): Source-grounded AI notebook that answers questions about documents you add. Category: Productivity. Pricing: Free / Paid.
- [Otter.ai](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=otter-ai): AI meeting notes and transcription. Category: Productivity. Pricing: Freemium.
- [Perplexity](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=perplexity): AI answer engine that searches the web and cites its sources. Category: Research. Pricing: Free / Paid.
- [Pi](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=pi): Personal AI chat assistant focused on conversation, advice and organisation. Category: Chatbots. Pricing: Free.
- [Sonix](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=sonix): Pay-as-you-go and subscription transcription with translation and subtitles. Category: Productivity. Pricing: Pay as you go / Paid.
- [Trint](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=trint): Transcription, translation and caption editing for audio and video. Category: Productivity. Pricing: Free trial / Paid.
- [You](https://aihubpedia.com/tool.php?id=you): AI search and answer platform with developer search APIs. Category: Research. Pricing: Free / Paid.
